evals.name: telemetry-region-labeling
evals.prompt: I've got a CSV of the car's (x, y) position from an obstacle-course RL episode, sampled every 100ms, at .agents/skills/obstacle-course-regions-workspace/iteration-1/telemetry_sample.csv (columns: t_ms, x, y, world meters -- same frame as /zed/zed_node/pose). Can you tell me which obstacle region each row falls into, and give me a quick summary of how much time it spent in each region?
evals.expected_output: A per-row region label using the skill's actual region names/bounds (not fabricated), plus a time-in-region summary (100ms per row). Two of the twelve rows (t=300ms and t=700ms) don't land inside any named region's box and should be reported as such (ordinary lane / no match) rather than forced into the nearest region.

evals.name: obstacle-order-and-gravel-bounds
evals.prompt: Quick one: what order do the obstacles come in on the CfR-2026 obstacle course, and what are the coordinate bounds of the gravel pit in world meters?
evals.expected_output: The 11 regions in driving order (overpass_ramp, helical_ramp, tunnel, narrow_region, gravel_pit, banked_turn, potholes, wide_open_region, buckets, hoops, car_wash) and gravel_pit's bounds, x [1.103, 3.541], y [-10.518, -9.299] in world meters, sourced from the GRAVEL constant.

evals.name: crash-point-lookup
evals.prompt: The car's ZED pose was (x=-3.0, y=-9.1) right before it flipped in sim -- what part of the obstacle course is that near?
evals.expected_output: This point falls outside every named region's bounds (just east of banked_turn's box). A good answer says so and names banked_turn as the nearest/likely region rather than silently asserting the point is inside it.
